response.sql: SELECT calibrstatus, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct > 47.6 GROUP BY calibrstatus;

assumptions.assumption: High bandwidth usage means strictly greater than 47.6.

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff includes telescopes with bandwidth usage equal to 47.6.
